values.eml_summary: The probabilistic side of every comparison: exact posteriors with numerical reliabilities, Beta-Bernoulli source-quality learning, the joint-likelihood common-cause model for correlated clusters (and its naive-independence negative control), and a Bayesian HMM for regime switches.
values.eml_summary_zh: 每次比較的概率端：帶數值可靠度的精確後驗、Beta-Bernoulli 來源品質學習、相關叢集的聯合概似共同因模型（及其天真獨立負控制），以及 regime 切換用的 Bayesian HMM。
